card.name: Small words inside ALL-CAPS warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking words (THE, AND, OF, HAS) and word pieces inside ALL-CAPS warning text, mostly in drug-label boxed warnings. It fires where the next word is likely to begin with B, such as BASIS or BECAUSE.

modes.label: Linking word before BASIS
modes.description: The word THE after INDIVIDUALIZED ON in the all-caps dosage-requirements warning.
modes.example: DOSAGE REQUIREMENTS ARE VARIABLE AND MUST BE INDIVIDUALIZED ON<< THE>> BASIS OF THE DISEASE AND THE

modes.label: AND or OF in capitalized phrases
modes.description: AND after 'YEARS OF AGE' and OF in an institute name, both in all caps.
modes.example: PEDIATRIC PATIENTS 2 YEARS OF AGE<< AND>> OLDER AND CONCOMITANT ADMIN

modes.label: Inside capitalized words
modes.description: A word piece partway through an all-caps drug name or plural.
modes.example: ASSOCIATED WITH THE USE OF ACET<<AM>>INOPHEN AT DOSES THAT EX

card.writes: It pushes the model toward predicting a next piece that begins with b (bind, beta, bp) and away from capital B.
card.plain: It fires on small words in all-caps warning text when a word starting with B is likely to come next.
